sidebar.title: Borrowing Fate
sidebar.p: Borrowed Fate Antagonists do not roll a fate die. Instead they Borrows Fate by inverting their oppoments Fate result.

For example, if Dourli attacked a goblin, typically Dourli would Roll a Fate and a Skill Die and the Goblin, the antagonist, would defend using either a Flat SSV or a by rolling an opposed skill die and adding their abilities rank. But the goblin never rolls a fate die. Instead he inverts the fate result from Dourli. So if Dourli rolls a Damned Fate then the Goblin Borrows that result and it becomes a Lucky Fate for the goblin. If Dourli rolls a Blessed Fate then for the goblin that is a Cursed Fate.
